dict.string: WaveFlow needs access to read the music files in your Downloads folder.
WaveFlow needs access to read the music files on your Desktop.
WaveFlow needs access to read the music files in your Documents folder.
WaveFlow needs access to read music from external drives and USB volumes.
WaveFlow needs access to read music from network shares and NAS volumes.
WaveFlow uses the local network to expose the optional DLNA MediaServer and MPD control surface.
